sources.name: Telefonica/EuroAlpaca
sources.languages: en, ast, bg, bs, ca, cs, cy, da, de, el, es, et, eu, fi, fo, fr, fur, ga, gd, gl, hr, hu, is, it, ka, lb, lij, lmo, lt, ltg, lv, mk, mt, nl, nno, nob, oci, pl, pt, ro, ru, sc, scn, sk, sl, sq, sr, sv, tr, uk, wa (52 European languages)
sources.description: Telefonica 发布的大规模欧洲多语言指令微调数据集，覆盖 52 种欧洲语言（含多种低资源语言如 Asturian、Friulian、Occitan、Sardinian 等），每种语言 51.8k 条指令样本。基于 synthetic data 生成，配套论文 arXiv:2609.05043。WMT 2026 MIST 共享任务中使用。

sources.name: KiranPal18/aya-med-multilingual-sft
sources.description: 基于 Aya 模型的多语言医学考试 QA SFT 数据集，覆盖英语、印地语、西班牙语、法语、阿拉伯语 5 种语言。包含真实医学考试多选题（A-D 选择），格式为 user/assistant 对话。适用于医疗领域 LLM 微调。

sources.name: ghanaopenai/nkrane-mt-parallel-corpus-eng-twi
sources.size: 未公开（含新闻、叙事等多领域）
sources.description: 英语-特维语（加纳阿坎语）平行语料库，包含命名实体标注（<entity>标签）。数据来源包括新闻、pristine narrative 等。Ghana Open AI 发布，对西非低资源语言 MT 有重要价值。
sources.search_keywords: parallel corpus, African language, Twi, Ghana

sources.name: Flex1-tech/fon-french-parallel-corpus
sources.description: 丰语-法语平行语料库（57.5k 句对），数据来源于 Zenodo（含 Fon_French_Parallel_Data_25377 等）。丰语是贝宁主要语言之一，属于低资源语言。适用于西非语言 MT 模型训练。

sources.name: toiar/english-pnar-parallel-corpus-100k
sources.description: 英语-Pnar 语平行语料库（109,122 句对）。Pnar 是印度梅加拉亚邦的南亚语系语言（Austroasiatic），由 Toiarbor Mawlieh 创建。适用于低资源语言 MT、跨语言嵌入研究。

sources.name: joanitolopo/kupangmalay-parallelcorpus
sources.size: 未公开（含圣经文本、日常对话等）
sources.description: 印尼语-古邦马来语平行语料库。古邦马来语是东努沙登加拉省的马来克里奥尔语，属于极低资源语言。数据来源包含圣经翻译文本。

sources.name: joanitolopo/flores-plus-austronesian
sources.languages: Austronesian languages (multiple: Indonesian, Malay, Javanese, etc.)
sources.description: FLORES+ 南岛语系扩展数据集，用于评估南岛语系语言的翻译和 NLP 模型质量。作为 FLORES+ 社区贡献（WMT 2026 OLDI 共享任务相关），扩展了低资源南岛语系覆盖。

sources.name: joanitolopo/flores-plus-sino_tibetan
sources.description: FLORES+ 汉藏语系扩展数据集，用于评估汉藏语系语言的翻译和 NLP 模型质量。扩展了 FLORES+ 对汉藏语系的覆盖。

sources.name: paulamartya25/multilingual-translation-data
sources.languages: en-pl, en-es, en-fr, en-ro, en-ur, en-ja, en-hi, en-sv 等 (OPUS-100 多语言对)
sources.description: 基于 OPUS-100 的多语言翻译数据集，包含英语与多种语言（波兰语、西班牙语、法语、罗马尼亚语、乌尔都语、日语、印地语、瑞典语等）的平行句对。来源标注为 opus100。

sources.name: adversarial-rl/llm-safety-benchmarks
sources.description: Adversarial RL Observatory 维护的 LLM 安全评估基准集，包含 OWASP LLM Top 10、MITRE ATLAS 威胁分类、红队测试协议、RAG 向量数据库安全评估等。覆盖 AI 安全审计、LLM 渗透测试、主权 AI 架构等方向。

sources.name: crawlcheck/agent-safety-benchmark
sources.description: CrawlCheck AI Agent 安全基准，测试 AI Agent 是否会登录仿冒域名、连接中毒工具、使用已撤销收据付款、根据过期信息行动等。每条记录含 Ed25519 签名和 Bitcoin 时间戳（OpenTimestamps），可验证。适用于 Agent 安全评估和训练奖励信号。

sources.name: HYUKI5/textdetox__multilingual_toxicity_dataset
sources.description: 多语言毒性检测数据集（TextDetox 项目），覆盖英语、俄语、乌克兰语、德语、西班牙语 5 种语言。每条含 text 和 toxic 标签（0/1），适用于内容审核和安全微调。

sources.name: SadikNawazAI/Sadik_Multilingual_Dataset_V2
sources.size: 未公开（schema 含 language, instruction, input, output, messages）
sources.description: 多语言指令微调数据集 V2，覆盖英语、印地语、日语、中文、德语。包含 instruction/input/output 格式和 messages 对话格式。注意：存在 schema cast 错误（Parquet 转换失败）。

sources.name: SadikNawazAI/sadik_multilingual_chat_dataset
sources.description: 多语言聊天对话数据集，覆盖英语、印地语、日语、中文、德语。与 Sadik_Multilingual_Dataset_V2 互补，侧重对话场景。

sources.name: Dataclusterlabspvtltd/Multilingual_OCR_Annotation_Dataset
sources.description: 多语言 OCR 标注数据集，覆盖希伯来语、泰语、日语、阿拉伯语 4 种文字系统差异较大的语言。适用于多语言文档理解和 OCR 模型训练。

sources.name: openbmb/UltraData-Code
sources.description: OpenBMB UltraData 代码数据集，更新於 2026-11-02。214 个点赞表明社区高度认可。

sources.name: openbmb/UltraData-Stack-v3-L2
sources.description: OpenBMB UltraData Stack v3 L2 层数据集，更新於 2026-11-02。UltraData 平台 L2 层级数据管理。

sources.name: JustANormalTinkerer/hayai-synth-multilingual
sources.description: Synthetic multilingual image-to-text dataset covering Korean, Chinese, and English. 'Hayai' (速い) suggests speed-focused synthesis.

sources.name: HYUKI5/nvidia__Nemotron-SFT-Multilingual-v2
sources.description: NVIDIA Nemotron SFT Multilingual v2 mirror — instruction tuning data covering 5 languages (English, Hindi, Japanese, Korean, Portuguese).

sources.name: vxltxrllc/fleurs-multilingual-voxtral-features
sources.description: Multilingual Voxtral audio features extracted from FLEURS dataset across 5 languages. Useful for speech model fine-tuning.

sources.name: InfoBayAI/Multilingual-mcq-qa-sample
sources.description: Multilingual MCQ (multiple choice question) QA sample dataset covering 5 Indic languages. Useful for knowledge QA evaluation.

sources.name: isaac369369/tiny-aya-safety-multilingual-results
sources.description: Tiny Aya safety evaluation results for English and Japanese. Part of a 3-dataset suite (results, training, prompts) for multilingual safety research.

sources.name: isaac369369/tiny-aya-safety-multilingual-training
sources.description: Tiny Aya safety training data for English and Japanese. Companion dataset to the results and prompts datasets.

sources.name: HYUKI5/MoritzLaurer__multilingual-NLI-26lang-2mil7
sources.description: Multilingual NLI (Natural Language Inference) dataset covering 26 languages with 2.7 million samples. Mirror of MoritzLaurer's popular NLI dataset.

sources.name: nakAnI-ai/English-Alexandrian-Arabic-parallel-corpus
sources.description: English-Alexandrian Arabic parallel corpus. Alexandrian Arabic is a distinct dialect, valuable for dialectal MT research.
sources.search_keywords: Alexandrian Arabic English parallel corpus dialect

sources.name: copsere211/palembang-indonesian-parallel-corpus
sources.description: Palembang-Indonesian parallel corpus. Palembang (plg) is a low-resource Malayic language spoken in South Sumatra, Indonesia.

sources.name: Tamajeq1286/tamajaq-english-parallel-corpus
sources.description: Tamajaq (Tamasheq/Berber)-English parallel corpus. Tamajaq is a Tuareg language spoken in the Sahel region. Very low-resource, high community interest (4 likes).
sources.search_keywords: Tamajaq Tamasheq Berber English parallel corpus

sources.name: stukenov/ekitil-corpus-parallel-kkru-v1
sources.description: Ekitil parallel corpus for Kazakh-Russian translation (v1). Central Asian language pair, relevant for Belt-and-Road NLP.
sources.search_keywords: Kazakh Russian parallel corpus Central Asian

sources.name: VardanSharma13/spectrum-sft-multilingual
sources.description: Spectrum SFT multilingual dataset covering QA, text classification, and summarization tasks across multiple languages.
sources.search_keywords: spectrum SFT multilingual QA classification summarization

sources.name: Jaswanth-0821/indic_language_parallel_dataset
sources.description: Indic language parallel dataset covering multiple Indian languages. Useful for Indic MT and cross-lingual transfer.
sources.search_keywords: Indic language parallel dataset Indian languages

sources.name: rodriguescarson/adaption-language-flores-indic-seed
sources.description: FLORES Indic seed adaptation dataset. Based on FLORES evaluation benchmarks, extended with Indic language seed data for translation adaptation.

sources.name: HYUKI5/CohereLabs__aya_dataset
sources.description: CohereLabs Aya dataset mirror — covers Arabic dialects (Standard Arabic, Moroccan, Najdi, Gulf) and Amharic. Part of the Aya multilingual instruction ecosystem.

sources.name: HYUKI5/Verah__JParaCrawl-Filtered-English-Japanese-Parallel-Corpus
sources.description: Filtered English-Japanese parallel corpus based on JParaCrawl. Quality-filtered variant for en-ja MT training.
sources.search_keywords: JParaCrawl English Japanese parallel corpus filtered

sources.name: HYUKI5/nvidia__Nemotron-RL-Instruction-Following-Structured-Outputs-v2
sources.description: NVIDIA Nemotron RL instruction following dataset for structured outputs (v2). English-only but high-quality RL training data applicable to cross-lingual IF transfer.
sources.search_keywords: Nemotron RL instruction following structured outputs NVIDIA

sources.name: HYUKI5/nvidia__Nemotron-RL-Instruction-Following-Adversarial-v1
sources.description: NVIDIA Nemotron RL adversarial instruction following dataset (v1). Contains challenging adversarial examples for robust IF training.
sources.search_keywords: Nemotron RL instruction following adversarial NVIDIA

sources.name: SalutefaceAAC/instruction-following-constraints
sources.description: Instruction following constraints dataset. English-only but focuses on constraint satisfaction in IF, applicable to multilingual IF training methodology.
